rows.text: returns when qword `[rcx+0xC8]` is 0; otherwise makes the call at `003C9840` + 0x13 with `rcx`, then takes `r` = the result of the call at `003C9840` + 0x29 with (`rcx`, 2 when the first call returned non-zero, else 1) and, when qword `[rcx+0xC8]` (re-read) is non-null, copies word `[r+0xC]` to word `+0x98` and word `[r+0xE]` to word `+0x9A` of that qword; returns no value

returns when qword `[rcx+0xC8]` is null; otherwise sets dword `+0x7C` of that qword to (its value AND 0x3FF7FF) OR 0x4B000800, makes the call at `003C98A0` + 0x2C with qword `[rcx+0xC8]` and clears bit 1 of dword `[rcx+0xC4]` (AND 0xFFFFFFFD)

notes: Both callers sit in 003C9A30. 003C9840: word [r+0xE] is loaded (sign-extended) before the null re-check of qword [rcx+0xC8], so r is dereferenced even when that store is skipped; the stores are 16-bit.
